lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dispersed series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid across the central and lower visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating an identifiable grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent horizontal ridge in the upper flank region characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, high-contrast feature located near the mid-flank spots, which does not conform to the surrounding skin morphology.
